newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabweans face jail, fine for anthem disrespect.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabweans face jail, fine for anthem disrespect.

text.p: The Zimbabwe government gazetted a rule on Friday, compelling courts to jail for a month or fine people convicted of "showing disrespect" to the southern African state's national anthem.

It said people were forbidden to remain seated, walk, move, make a noise and show any form of disrespect when the anthem -- called Blessed Be The Land of Zimbabwe -- was being sung or played at schools or public events.
"Any person who shows any disrespect while the anthem is being sung or played is liable to a fine of Z$500 (U.S.$44.24) or one month in jail."
